protocol.replication_disclosure: The original cross-day replication and the prepared same-day R2 replication were waived by the owner after Day-1. This reconnection must not be described as an independent or cross-day replication PASS.

r4_invalidation.cause: Real decode passes attention_mask=None because the last causal token sees all cached positions; the locked candidate contract requires an explicit contiguous BF16 zero mask.
r4_invalidation.secondary_observation: An all-eager fallback replay differed from the archived OP3 A2 token list after a fresh NF4 model load, so a cross-process archived token list is not a valid strict oracle for R5.
r4_invalidation.disposition: R4 is retained as an invalid execution attempt and contributes no reconnection decision.

r5_changes.mask_normalization: For decode-shaped calls only, normalize attention_mask=None to a contiguous BF16 zero tensor [1,1,1,K]. Non-None masks remain unchanged.
r5_changes.probe_evidence: The real first decode call had contiguous BF16 Q/K/V, dropout=0, scaling=1, softcap=None, output_attentions=false; eligibility changed from false to true only after None-to-zero-mask normalization.
r5_changes.oracle: Run one full eager A path and one full K3 B path inside the same model load, with fresh cache and the same seed for each request; compare token lists directly.
r5_changes.registry_cleanup: Remove the temporary attention function from AttentionInterface._global_mapping, matching Transformers register() semantics.

reconnection.schema: k3_gqa_attention(Tensor query, Tensor key, Tensor value, Tensor attention_mask) -> Tensor

replay_protocol.schedule: all 11 A requests, prewarm 26 bounded shapes, then all 11 B requests
replay_protocol.eos_policy: record EOS but do not truncate
replay_protocol.kv_policy: fresh DynamicCache per request; no cache crosses request boundaries

length_bucket_adapter.reason: The locked Triton candidate specializes/autotunes on exact K, while full-attention K advances every decode token. Padding to a frozen correctness-covered upper bucket bounds compilation without changing the three candidate kernels.
length_bucket_adapter.sliding: K remains exactly 512 and is not padded
length_bucket_adapter.padding: K/V append BF16 zeros and the additive mask appends torch.finfo(torch.bfloat16).min; exact bucket hits use the original tensors.
length_bucket_adapter.prewarm: Run one untracked custom-op call for sliding K=512 and each full upper bucket before B replay so compilation/autotune is excluded from B request timing.
length_bucket_adapter.evidence_boundary: The adapter receives no isolated or ncu performance claim. Its deployment correctness is decided only by the same-load full replay exact-token gate.

limitations: The original cross-day replication and the prepared same-day R2 replication were waived by the owner after Day-1. This reconnection must not be described as an independent or cross-day replication PASS.
R5 uses one same-load A pass and one same-load B pass; it is a deployment equivalence test, not a repeatability claim.
The length-bucket and None-to-zero-mask adapters are judged only by same-load deployment equivalence and receive no isolated/ncu speed claim.
Results are local to the C02 NF4 sm_89 carrier and output_attentions=false decode path.
